about: The announcer lines made by cloning the recorded announcer's voice (tools/clone_announcer_lines.py). AI-generated, with the announcer's consent, 2026-10-05. See Assets/TumbangPreso/Resources/Vo/AI_CLONED_LINES.md and docs/HUMAN.md. One line id may have several takes: VoiceDirector cycles the takes of an id, so alternate wordings of one moment are takes of one id and share its caption.

fields.id: the id VoiceDirector plays; the file is Resources/Vo/vo_<id>_<n>.wav
fields.caption: what VoiceDirector.CaptionFor shows (English meaning)
fields.wiring: the call site that plays it, or 'none': a line with no trigger is generated for audition only (Logs/arena/voice/unwired) and is not put in Resources
fields.takes[].text: the line as written (the canonical spelling; the recogniser's transcript is compared with this)
fields.takes[].language: fil or en. The model has no Filipino mode: a fil line is tried in its Swahili, Malay, Spanish and English modes with the Filipino spelling, and the take a Tagalog recogniser hears best is kept
fields.takes[].say: optional [[mode, spoken text], ...] to try instead of the defaults (a respelling for a word the model gets wrong)
fields.takes[].syllables: optional; counted from the vowels otherwise
fields.takes[].pick: optional: a candidate's file stem (Logs/arena/voice/candidates/<id>_<n>/) to ship instead of the best-scoring one; 'none' to ship nothing

not_written.what: Match point, set point, round winner
not_written.why: docs/HUMAN.md: scores are cumulative with no target and nobody wins a round, so the game has no such moment.

not_written.what: More takes of count_*, clock_30, clock_10, match_win, match_draw
not_written.why: Those are the announcer's own recordings. A cloned take is never put in rotation beside a human one.

lines.caption: Welcome to the Arena!
lines.when: Arena, round 1, 5.6 s after the round starts, on the organ
lines.delivery: Big and warm, the stadium greeting. Two beats.

lines.caption: Next stage!
lines.when: Arena, in a break, as the next layout's hologram sweeps in
lines.delivery: A call to attention, level, certain.

lines.caption: Plaza!
lines.when: Arena, in a break, 2.3 s after 'Next stage!', the layout's name

lines.caption: Tower!
lines.when: As arena_plaza, for the Tore layout
lines.delivery: One word, announced. TO-reh, both syllables.

lines.caption: Cross!
lines.when: As arena_plaza, for the Krus layout

lines.caption: Pit!
lines.when: As arena_plaza, for the Hukay layout

lines.caption: Stage!
lines.when: As arena_plaza, for the Entablado layout

lines.caption: The balloon popped!
lines.when: Arena, 1.6 s after the slipper balloon is popped, after the air horn

lines.caption: Caught! Back in the game!
lines.when: Arena, 1.5 s after the drone sets a fallen player back on a deck
lines.delivery: Relief, then a push back into play. Two beats.

lines.caption: It's down!
lines.when: Every map: the can is knocked over
lines.delivery: The money line (docs/HUMAN.md Table A). Give it everything.

lines.caption: You're it!
lines.when: Every map: round 1 starts, and each tag the taya lands
lines.wiring: MatchRpc -> VoiceDirector.OnRoundStarted, MatchFlair -> OnAttackerTagged (already wired; 5 s cooldown)
lines.delivery: Short and sharp, so the contact stays audible.

lines.caption: Back up!
lines.when: Every map: the taya stands the can up again

lines.caption: Hurry!
lines.when: Every map: 15 s left in a round (docs/HUMAN.md Table B)

lines.caption: Nice!
lines.when: A tag lands (docs/HUMAN.md Table B)
lines.wiring: none (VoiceDirector has a cooldown for it and no call site)

lines.caption: Tumbang Preso!
lines.when: The main menu, once, on load (docs/HUMAN.md Table C)
lines.wiring: none (no call site in the menu)

lines.caption: So close!
lines.when: Arena: a throw misses the can by very little (MatchFlair.Kind.NearMiss)

lines.caption: What a throw!
lines.when: Arena: a throw banks off the scenery and still counts (MatchFlair.Kind.BankShot)

lines.caption: Blocked!
lines.when: Arena: a slipper is stopped by a body (MatchFlair.Kind.Block)

lines.caption: Over the edge!
lines.when: Arena: a player falls down the shaft, with the crowd's 'ooh'

lines.caption: The balloon's hit!
lines.when: Arena: the slipper balloon is hit and not yet popped, with the crowd's laugh

lines.caption: Round over!
lines.when: Arena: a round ends and the break begins
lines.wiring: none (MatchDirector.IntermissionStarted exists, but the line would hold the announcer when 'Next stage!' is due, and the break's timing is being reworked)

lines.caption: Thank you, Arena!
lines.when: Arena: after the result, as the stands applaud
lines.wiring: none (MatchDirector.MatchEnded exists, but the winner's own line and 'Winner!' are speaking then)

lines.caption: New leader!
lines.when: Somebody takes the lead
lines.wiring: none (MatchMomentKind.LeadChange exists, but HeroVoice gives that moment to the hero who took it)

lines.caption: All tied up!
lines.when: The top scores are level during a match

lines.caption: Final round!
lines.when: The last round of a match starts
lines.wiring: none (VoiceDirector.OnRoundStarted is given the round number, not the number of rounds)
